Executive Summary: OpenAI Technology Stack & Infrastructure

OpenAI utilizes PyTorch as its primary deep learning framework for training large-scale GPT models.
The infrastructure runs on high-performance NVIDIA GPU clusters equipped with CUDA and HBM3e high-bandwidth memory.
Model deployment is orchestrated using Kubernetes and optimized custom C++ CUDA kernels.

text:
Real-World Scenario
Delhi faces a deluge of waste on its roads
1.With its overloaded landfills and lack of coordination between various
stakeholders, Delhi continues to have an inefficient waste management system.
2.The city generates over 11,000 tons of waste daily. However, it faces
significant challenges due to poor waste segregation.

text:
Real World Scenario
Waste Dumping in Tamil Nadu
1.Tamil Nadu generates about 14,200-15,200 tonnes of municipal solid
waste per day.
2.The state processes around 66% of this waste.
3.The remaining ~34% (~5,000 tonnes per day) ends up in landfills or
unmanaged places which includes roadsides, open lands, drains, etc.

text:
Proposed Solution
• Users report waste by uploading photos
• The system automatically captures the exact geo-location
• AI verifies the image, identifies waste type category
• Multiple reports from the same geo-tagged location increases priority
• Authorities view real-time waste hotspots
• Cleaning staff receive assigned tasks with location
• After cleaning, staffs upload an after-clean image and awards credit
points

text:
Competitor Analysis
• Swachhata App (India)
Allows citizens to upload waste complaints with image and geo-location
Does not use AI verification and lacks accountability for timely cleaning.
• Our AI-Driven Approach
Uses AI to verify waste and assign priority
Multiple reports from the same geo-tagged location increases priority
Authorities view real-time waste hotspots
AI verifies cleanliness and awards credit points to cleaners

Limitations of Existing System
• Manual Reporting Process
• No AI Verification
• Lack of Priority Handling
• Delayed Response Time
• No Real-Time Tracking
